cqa_tuples.target_criteria: any of: concatenating multiple frames / single transmission / not releasing channel control counts as the definition

cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Frame bursting reduces the overhead for transmitting small frames by concatenating a sequence of multiple frames in one single transmission, without ever releasing control of the channel.
